11: ## Executive Summary
12: 
13: `cinejoy.pk` is a single-page application (SPA) built on **SvelteKit** (using `@sveltejs/kit` with static client-side hydration) protected at the edge by **DDOS-Guard**. The website does **not** rely on server-side HTML rendering (SSR) for catalog content, nor does it have a proprietary monolithic backend for catalog metadata. Instead, the architecture is a **decoupled, multi-service streaming client** that coordinates:
14: 
15: 1. **The Movie Database (TMDB) API v3**: Directly queried from the client using public API key `8476a7ab80ad76f0936744df0430e67c` for all catalog browsing, trending/top-rated carousels, genre/year/provider filtering, multi-search, cast/credits, posters/backdrops, and season/episode metadata.
16: 2. **Wing Lists API (`lists.wing.st`)**: Provides curated editorial lists (Oscar Nominees, Cannes, Halloween, Rotten Tomatoes Best of All Time, Mindfuck Movies, True Story) with full item metadata and cross-platform rating aggregations (IMDB, Letterboxd, Metacritic, Rotten Tomatoes, RogerEbert).
17: 3. **Wing Community/Social Server (`server.wing.st`)**: REST endpoints for community user lists search, title upvotes, and comments.
18: 4. **Wing Subtitles API (`subs.wing.st`)**: Multi-lingual subtitle discovery endpoint supporting 280+ SRT subtitle streams per title, backed by MovieBox/Chuaxin steganographic storage.
19: 5. **TheIntroDB API (`api.theintrodb.org`)**: Precision crowd-sourced intro and end-credits timestamp database for automatic intro/credit skipping.
20: 6. **Wing Stream Resolver & Cipher Gateway (`api.wing.st`)**: A proprietary cryptographic gateway utilizing a custom WebAssembly binary (`crush.wasm`, protocol codename `lumen-gate-v2`) and AES-256-GCM encryption over an unformatted binary HTTP POST endpoint (`/g`).
21: 7. **Lightspeed CDN (`lightspeed.st`)**: High-throughput Cloudflare-fronted HLS video distribution network delivering multi-bitrate fragmented MP4 streams (360p, 720p, 1080p, 4K 2160p HDR PQ) with independent English 5.1/stereo audio tracks disguised as steganographic `.png` chunks (`init.png`, `seg-v*.png`).

13: The cinejoy-webos application is a 10-foot television streaming client designed for the LG webOS 8.5 platform. 15: ### 1.1 Purpose
16: The purpose of `app/test-m4.js` is to provide a deterministic, fully automated, offline verification harness for all Milestone 4 features of the `cinejoy-webos` application:
17: 1. **TMDB API v3 & Wing Lists Client (`app/js/tmdb.js`)**: Endpoint URL construction, query parameter serialization, response payload normalization, CDN image helpers, memory-bounded LRU/TTL caching, and network fault tolerance.
18: 2. **Home View Dynamic Population (`#view-home`)**: Data binding of trending hero banners, multi-shelf generation (Trending Movies, Trending Series, Top Rated, Curated), card count thresholds, and 2:3 poster geometry.
19: 3. **Catalog & Filter View (`#view-movies`, `#view-series`)**: Dynamic genre pill bars, sorting controls, release year filtering, 6-column 2D grid rendering, pagination triggers, and empty/error states.
20: 4. **Search View & TV Virtual Keyboard (`#view-search`)**: 10-foot on-screen keyboard navigation, key press simulation, query string accumulation, debounced multi-search dispatch, and results grid population.
21: 5. **Content Details & TV Episode Carousel (`#view-details`)**: Movie metadata binding, cast carousel, TV show season tabs, 16:9 episode still cards, and "Watch Now" action payload dispatch to the player.
22: 6. **Spatial Navigation of Dynamic Content**: Verification that dynamically generated DOM nodes declare `data-nav="true"`, maintain spatial coordinates, preserve 2D grid alignments, trigger TV-safe auto-scrolling, and honor focus memory across view transitions.
23: 
24: ### 1.2 Performance & Execution Constraints
25: - **Zero Internet Dependency**: The test runner must execute 100% offline. All calls to `api.themoviedb.org`, `image.tmdb.org`, and `lists.wing.st` are intercepted by an in-memory mock network router.

54: ## 2. Logic Chain
55: 
56: 1. **Race Condition in `PlayerController.loadStream` (Bug 1):**
57:    - *Observation (app/js/player.js lines 198-260 & 371-427):* `loadStream` sets `this.currentItem = itemPayload` and initiates `this._resolveStreamWithFallback(...)`. Upon resolution, `.then(function (streamData) { return self._attachAndPlayStream(streamData); })` is invoked.
58:    - *Logic:* `loadStream` has no generation sequence counter (`loadSeq` / `token`). When a user rapidly switches between media items (e.g. 5 titles in rapid succession), network latency variations cause out-of-order resolution. A slower earlier request (e.g. Item 1004 taking 30ms) resolves after a faster later request (Item 1005 taking 10ms). Because `_attachAndPlayStream` unconditionally attaches `streamData.streamUrl` without verifying that `streamData` belongs to the current `this.currentItem`, the older media overwrites the newer media. 61:    - *Observation (app/js/player.js lines 888-958 & 270-289):* When the user leaves playback, `PlayerController.destroy()` sets `this.state = 'IDLE'` and aborts `this._abortController`. In `_resolveStreamWithFallback`, that error is caught, and because `fallbackIndex < CLUSTER_SERVERS.length - 1`, it initiates fallback fetches to `Nebula`, `Lisbon`, `Solara`, and `Athens` *after the player is already destroyed*. 68:        if (!this.videoElement) return;

12: ## 1. Executive Summary & Architecture Overview
13: 
14: The Cinejoy webOS TV application is engineered for the **LG 32LR686BPSA** television. It provides a 10-foot living-room cinema experience running at native **1920×1080 (1080p Full HD)** with a 60 FPS rendering target, deterministic spatial D-pad remote navigation, and hardware-accelerated HLS/fMP4 video playback.
